header.title: Test case generation workbench
header.description: Freeze a Skill target for “{{name}}”, generate cases with Claude, then review the validated draft before saving an immutable revision.

tasks.title: Generation tasks
tasks.empty: No Evals have been generated. Use the generate button to configure a target and begin.

drawer.createDescription: Configure the frozen target and start generation. Closing the drawer does not cancel a running task.
drawer.detailDescription: Inspect the controlled Agent process, validated result, and human save state.
drawer.activeTaskHint: A generation task is already running. Wait for it to finish, or open that task and cancel it.
drawer.reviewBeforeSave: Review the cases before saving this test case set.
drawer.closeHint: Closing the drawer does not affect task execution.

progress.title: Building an Evals draft
progress.endedTitle: This generation did not produce a reviewable draft
progress.description: Target Skill: {{skillName}}. Output is checked for basic structure and declared input files.
progress.agentThinking: The Agent completed an analysis message

error.generic: The generated result cannot be used as test cases yet. Adjust the task and try again.
error.outputMissing: No generated test case file was found.
error.jsonInvalid: The generated test case file is not readable JSON.
error.rootInvalid: The generated result has no usable test case list.
error.caseInvalid: At least one test case is incomplete or incorrectly formatted.
error.promptInvalid: The test task includes internal execution instructions and cannot run as a real user task.
error.fileMissing: A test case references an input file that does not exist.
error.fileInvalid: A referenced input file path or file type is invalid.
error.startFailed: The generation environment could not be prepared. Try again.

evalsJson.MISSING: No test case file was generated.
evalsJson.INVALID_JSON: The test case file could not be parsed.
evalsJson.ROOT_INVALID: The test case file has no valid case list.
evalsJson.VALID: The test case file was read. Its generation summary is shown below.

failureSummary.incompleteCase: Test case {{index}} is missing required content.
failureSummary.ignoredFiles: These extra files will not be used by later tests: {{files}}.

review.title: Review Evals draft
review.emptyDescription: Generation never saves automatically. Review every user task, expected result, objective assertion, and input file after validation.
review.resultPendingTitle: The generation result is not ready
review.resultPendingDescription: The complete cases will be available here after the Agent finishes and server validation succeeds.
review.noInputFiles: This case has no input files

controls.title: Generation settings
controls.briefPlaceholder: For example: prioritize scanned documents, missing fields, and multi-currency boundaries.
controls.freezeHint: Starting freezes the selected target and copies the Skill and Claude settings into an isolated workspace. Source files are never written back.

save.title: Save test cases
save.noDraft: Select a successfully validated task to review its draft summary and save actions.
save.runTest: Run tests with this test case set
save.confirm: Saved Evals revisions cannot be changed. Confirm that every case has been reviewed and that you want to save this test case set?
save.discardConfirm: A discarded draft cannot be saved, but its task record remains. Discard it?

status.PUBLISHED: Saved as a test case revision

revisions.title: Saved test cases
revisions.empty: No Evals revisions have been saved.
